access.notes: Open-source MD code. The solving agent must compile or use a pre-built version with the USER-TTM package.
The AIREBO potential file (e.g. CH.airebo) is part of standard LAMMPS installations.

resources.name: Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for nickel (Mishin et al. 1999)

access.notes: The Ni EAM potential file is publicly available from the NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository.

resources.name: Morse potential parameters for nickel-carbon interactions (Tang et al. 2013)

access.notes: The Morse parameters (D0, alpha, r0) for Ni-C must be obtained from the published paper. The solving agent can write a tabulated potential file for LAMMPS using these values.

notes: All resources are publicly available. LAMMPS with USER-TTM is required. The Morse potential parameters are taken from Tang et al. 2013; the agent must construct the potential table.
